title: Cross-surface wiring and integration

any: two or more selected implementation producers must interact
an adapter, provider, queue, or generated client is wired
combined behavior cannot be accepted locally

skill_calls.when: wiring crosses public or runtime boundaries
integration code or configuration is required

nodes.obligation: Connect selected producers without duplicating contract authority.
Validate combined behavior against exact producer versions and environment.

tests.evidence: combined producers exchange current contract data and preserve failure behavior

workline_policy: Use a distinct workline when wiring has separate writes, ownership, environment, or integrated evidence; otherwise synthesize an aggregate gate.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when one selected implementation producer can prove the complete outcome without a cross-boundary join.
repair: Integration failure identifies the earliest responsible producer or wiring node and preserves unrelated accepted producers.
